The season group photo, one per year, oldest first. "dated" picks up any photo in the "our history" Drive folder whose name is a year — so adding next season's shot means naming a file 2027 and nothing else. The year prints under the frame rather than over the photograph.
Everything in the same folder that is NOT named after a year: the two newspaper clippings. They are scans of newsprint, so they link to the full-size file — a clipping nobody can read is decoration.
